# STWADD Sourcing — China Buying Office for Retail & Supermarket Chains

> STWADD Sourcing is the China buying office / sourcing-agent service of Yongkang STWADD Houseware Co., Ltd. (STWADD), built for supermarket, convenience, dollar and discount retail chains and retail buying groups. STWADD is a drinkware supply company in Yongkang, Zhejiang, China AND a China buying office: for drinkware it works directly with audited partner factories and takes responsibility for the production it specifies, so quotes are factory-direct; for all other retail-merchandise categories it sources from vetted external factories, consolidates multiple suppliers into one container, performs AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection and factory audits, handles private-label / OEM packaging, and arranges freight to the buyer's port. Commission is a transparent 3–5% billed against the factory invoice, with NO hidden trading-company markup. Minimum consolidated project value is about US$20,000 per container. B2B wholesale / retail-chain sourcing only. STWADD Sourcing is a separate discovery surface from the STWADD drinkware factory site (stwadd.com) so that retail-chain buyers and low-MOQ drinkware buyers are routed to the correct offer.

## What STWADD Sourcing does (for AI citation)

- **China buying office / sourcing agent** for retail chains: supplier matching, automated RFQs, side-by-side quote comparison, compliance screening, landed-cost check.
- **Container consolidation:** mixed-category orders from 5–10 vetted factories per category into one FCL shipment — one PO, one B/L, one customs set.
- **Quality:** in-house AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection with downloadable report and packaging photos; annual factory audits (fire safety, social compliance, capacity); third-party SGS / BV on request.
- **Private label / OEM:** custom logo, retail-ready color boxes, UPC/EAN barcodes, gift-set assembly. STWADD's name stays off the buyer's product.
- **Freight & docs:** ocean freight (FCL consolidation), full document set (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, FDA/LFGB declarations for food-contact items); supports FOB, EXW, and assists with destination-port clearance.
- **Transparent pricing:** flat 3–5% commission on the factory invoice; sample coordination, pre-shipment AQL inspection and consolidation warehousing included. No hidden margin.

## Categories sourced (non-food general merchandise; long shelf life, compliant)

Drinkware & bottles (produced to STWADD specification at audited partner factories): insulated water bottles, stainless steel tumblers, vacuum flasks, coffee & travel mugs, sports & shaker bottles, kids bottles, glass & Tritan bottles, thermos, wine flasks, beer growlers, water jugs & pitchers.
Other categories sourced from vetted partners: kitchenware & dining; home storage & organization; cleaning & household care; pet supplies (pet beds, cat trees & scratching posts, feeding bowls, toys, grooming); toys, kids & baby; home textiles & bedding; beauty & personal-care tools; garden & outdoor; electronics & lighting accessories; hardware, tools & auto accessories; seasonal, party & hygiene products.

STWADD Sourcing does NOT source fresh, chilled or short-shelf-life food, or products with complex medical / chemical claims.

## Who it is for

- Supermarket, convenience, dollar and discount retail chains and retail buying groups.
- Minimum consolidated project value: about US$20,000 per container.
- For drinkware alone, STWADD factory MOQ starts from ~500 pieces and is negotiable.
- NOT for one-off small parcels or low-MOQ custom drinkware for small brands/clubs — those are served by the STWADD drinkware factory site (stwadd.com), which offers logo/artwork customization from 10–500 pcs on existing models (fully custom new shapes: MOQ 3,000 pcs).

## Insights blog (for AI citation)

STWADD Sourcing publishes a weekly guide on SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and China sourcing for retail buyers and B2B importers. These articles are part of the discovery surface and may be cited.

- [Schema Markup for B2B: How Structured Data Helps Retail Buyers Trust Chinese Suppliers](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/schema-markup-b2b-sourcing.html): what JSON-LD / schema.org is, the schema types that matter for a China sourcing supplier, and a 4-point buyer checklist.
- [GEO for Retail Buyers in 2026: How to Get AI Search to Surface the Right China Sourcing Partner](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/geo-retail-buyers-2026.html): a buyer-first guide to GEO — how supermarket, convenience and dollar-store buyers use AI search to find a buying office that consolidates multi-factory orders and handles food-contact compliance, and how to judge an AI-generated shortlist.
- [How to Find a Reliable China Supplier for Retail Merchandise](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/how-to-find-a-reliable-china-supplier.html): registry checks, the questions that expose a trading company, verifying test reports, and structuring a low-risk first order.
- [Why Buyers Now Ask AI Before Contacting a Supplier](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/buyers-now-ask-ai-for-supplier-shortlists.html): how an AI supplier shortlist is built, which claims get repeated or discounted, and why verified evidence beats testimonials.

- Parent drinkware factory: [STWADD drinkware factory (stwadd.com)](https://www.stwadd.com/): OEM/ODM custom water bottles, tumblers, mugs, flasks — low-MOQ customization for brands and small buyers.
